content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
[h1]EOC - Executive Operations Center[/h1]
A governance-first operations layer for X4: Foundations. EOC observes your empire, explains recurring station problems, recommends bounded actions, and keeps execution under player control.
[h2]Important Startup Timing[/h2]
After loading a game, wait about 10 seconds for the initial station scan to complete before opening EOC. The readiness summary confirms current data is available.
[h2]What EOC Does[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Executive Intelligence[/b] - Empire health, operational KPIs, trends, ranked attention, and station summaries.
[*][b]Station Management[/b] - Persistent station roles, role-aware recommendations, advisory operating policies, production, workforce, economy, and storage intelligence.
[*][b]Guided Recovery[/b] - One blocker at a time, supporting evidence, one recommended player action, and fresh verification.
[*][b]Safe Market-Path Tests[/b] - Preview and confirm one bounded NPC-enabled BUY or SELL offer without changing existing ware rules or ordinary offers.
[*][b]Managed Trade[/b] - Evidence-supported EOC trade offers within authority explicitly granted by the player.
[*][b]Shipping and Logistics[/b] - Register eligible ships, scan needs, approve assignments, or use bounded automatic assignment.
[*][b]Fleet Build Manager[/b] - Save fleet templates, search owned blueprints, preview one-yard or distributed construction, and confirm normal player-yard orders.
[*][b]Cases and Verification[/b] - Track critical, warning, monitored, and player-requested cases; report Resolved, Improving, Unchanged, or Worsening from fresh evidence.
[*][b]Reports[/b] - Immediate EOC reports plus permanent Logbook Tips copies.
[*][b]Player-Controlled Safety[/b] - Deliberate previews, amber confirmations, exact cleanup, duplicate prevention, no free ships, no resource bypass, and no automatic credit movement.
[*][b]Personal Office Access[/b] - Open EOC from Dock Interactions in the Personal Office; separate pinwheel navigation remains available.
[*][b]Named Command Intelligence[/b] - Choose a persistent EOC name and enjoy a guided startup sequence clearly separated from operational evidence.
[/list]
[h2]Latest Release - EOC 2.4 GA[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adds one-step-at-a-time Guided Recovery with separate Next Action, Evidence Details, and Verify Result views.
[*]Carries stable case provenance so bounded market tests resolve the exact original station and ware.
[*]Creates one evidence-sized NPC BUY or SELL test while preserving existing rules and ordinary offers.
[*]Removes only EOC's matching test offer and locks completed creation and removal against repeats.
[*]Uses consistent amber pending-confirmation buttons across market, fleet, ship-order, role, and policy controls.
[*]Adds clear guidance for adopting a successful market path permanently without silently changing policy.
[/list]
[h2]Make a Successful Market Test Permanent[/h2]
EOC never converts a bounded test into permanent policy automatically. Open the station Logical Overview, select the tested ware's buy or sell offer, and change only its ware-specific trade rule. Change a station-wide rule only when you intend the wider effect. Then remove the temporary EOC test offer.
[h2]Getting Started[/h2]
1. Load the game and wait about 10 seconds for EOC initialization.
2. Open Dock Interactions using the icon immediately to the right of Diplomacy.
3. Select OPEN EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS CENTER.
4. On first use, choose a name for the command intelligence.
EOC supports X4 8.x and 9.x. Removing EOC does not make an existing save dependent on the mod.
[h2]Credits[/h2]

Special thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/XaosSpecter][b]Reuivn[/b][/url] for proposing Personal Office access. Thanks to [b]UPB[/b] for technical advice and permission to use approved ship-lifecycle concepts and code.
